key_insight: Syn4D provides a large multiview synthetic dataset of dynamic scenes with dense, pixel-accurate geometric and tracking annotations (camera motion, depth, dense tracking, and parametric human pose), enabling rigorous evaluation of 3D reconstruction and tracking from monocular video.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of high-quality datasets that offer dense, complete, and accurate geometric annotations for dynamic scenes, which has limited progress in dense 3D reconstruction and tracking research.
method: Procedurally generate and render multiview dynamic scenes with controlled camera trajectories and diverse motions.
Produce per-frame ground-truth annotations including camera poses, depth maps, dense pixel-level tracking, and parametric human pose labels.
Package data for benchmarking and evaluation of reconstruction/tracking algorithms across varied dynamic scenarios.
impact: Provides a standardized, richly annotated benchmark that lets researchers reliably evaluate and compare algorithms for dynamic 3D reconstruction and tracking, accelerating development and reproducibility in the field.
